title: 2015 AMC 12B Problem 7
statement: A regular \(15\)-gon has \(L\) lines of symmetry, and the smallest positive angle for which it has rotational symmetry is \(R\) degrees. What is \(L + R?\)

solutions.text:
A regular \(15\)-gon has \(L = 15\) lines of symmetry, and its smallest angle of rotational symmetry is \(R = \dfrac{360}{15} = 24\) degrees.

Then \(L + R = 15 + 24 = 39.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: A regular \(n\)-gon has \(n\) lines of symmetry
Its smallest rotational symmetry angle is \(\dfrac{360^\circ}{n}\)
